restaurant_name: หมอพจน์ สหคลินิก (Dr.Poj Polyclinic)
text: Clinic where you can get not just a doctor, but a dentist and aesthetician! Very good service and great one stop location!

restaurant_name: หมอพจน์ สหคลินิก (Dr.Poj Polyclinic)
text:
We visited this clinic twice and both times we had more than excellent service. The first time my husband visited for a knee injury and Dr. Poj was very attentive, addressed all his needs, and extremely kind and professional! The clinic is very clean, modern, and the staff are friendly and capable.
The second time we visited, Dr. Poj personally took me to the hospital to make sure my prescriptions were filled properly as we are expatriates and don’t speak Thai. As Canadians who travel the world, I can tell you that this level of service and that too accommodating us in English, is not easy to find. We highly recommend this doctor and this clinic and we will always be thankful for the care we received. I must also mention  that it is at an extremely reasonable price even for Thai standards of pricing. If you are in Chiang Mai and need to see a doctor or dentist, this is the place. Parking available in the back.

restaurant_name: หมอพจน์ สหคลินิก (Dr.Poj Polyclinic)
text: Dr. Poj Multidisciplinary Clinic is a comprehensive clinic that instills confidence from the moment you step inside. The new building is clean, modern, and spacious, with greenery in the center creating a relaxing atmosphere. The interior is well-organized, avoiding a cramped feeling, and there's convenient parking at the back for patients. In terms of treatment, it offers a full range of services, including general medical checkups, physiotherapy, and consultations with specialist orthopedic doctors. Additionally, there's a professional beauty clinic with proven results and a dental clinic that accepts social security insurance, making it a one-stop shop for both health and beauty needs. A standout feature is the friendly and attentive nature of the doctors, who provide detailed explanations, along with the polite and welcoming counter staff who provide excellent service to both Thai and international patients. Overall, it's a complete, convenient, and well-equipped multidisciplinary clinic, ideal for those seeking quality medical care in this area.

text:

The clinic is clean, with a tree in the center. Parking is available behind the clinic. There are three clinics inside: an orthopedic clinic, a dental clinic, and a plastic surgery clinic.

text: I had the opportunity to use the services at Dr. Poj's Clinic. I took my niece to see Dr. Siripoj for treatment of a sprained ankle caused by a sports injury. I also went for a dental check-up with Dr. Benz. It turned out I had several cavities and needed scaling and fillings. I was very impressed with the first day; the doctor was kind, attentive, and very friendly. So I decided to get all 11 fillings done. I was impressed from the moment I walked in. The doctor was kind and lovely, the clinic was very clean, and parking was convenient. I was very impressed with the doctor. I'm quite selective, especially when it comes to taking care of myself and those around me. I love myself and my body so I can be with the people I love and my family for a long time. It's important to observe and take care of yourself, and most importantly, have a doctor you trust to help you and be honest about the body that you need to be with for a long time. I love Dr. Poj's Clinic and won't change my mind. ❤️
